command:
cat <<'ANTRIEB_EOF' | sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/issue-cert.sh > /dev/null
#!/bin/sh
# Issues a fresh short-lived leaf cert signed by the local CA and
# atomically installs it for nginx, then reloads nginx (no downtime).
set -e
LIFETIME_SECONDS=240
CN="${NODE_IP:-node1}"
WORKDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT

openssl req -new -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout "$WORKDIR/leaf.key" -out "$WORKDIR/leaf.csr" \
    -subj "/CN=$CN" >/tmp/issue-cert.log 2>&1

ENDDATE=$(date -u -d "+${LIFETIME_SECONDS} seconds" +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ)

openssl ca -config /etc/nginx/ca/ca.cnf -batch \
    -enddate "$ENDDATE" \
    -in "$WORKDIR/leaf.csr" -out "$WORKDIR/leaf.crt" >>/tmp/issue-cert.log 2>&1

cat "$WORKDIR/leaf.crt" /etc/nginx/ca/ca.crt > "$WORKDIR/fullchain.pem"

install -m 640 -o root -g root "$WORKDIR/leaf.key" /etc/nginx/certs/key.pem.new
install -m 644 -o root -g root "$WORKDIR/fullchain.pem" /etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem.new
mv -f /etc/nginx/certs/key.pem.new /etc/nginx/certs/key.pem
mv -f /etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem.new /etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem

nginx -t >>/tmp/issue-cert.log 2>&1 && systemctl reload nginx

echo "$(date -u -Iseconds) issued cert serial=$(openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem -noout -serial) notAfter=$(openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem -noout -enddate)" >> /var/log/cert-renew.log
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo -n chmod 750 /usr/local/sbin/issue-cert.sh
sudo -n cat /usr/local/sbin/issue-cert.sh | head -5

#!/bin/sh
# Renews the nginx cert when it is within RENEW_THRESHOLD seconds of expiry.

if [ -f "$CERT" ] && openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -checkend "$RENEW_THRESHOLD"; then
    exit 0
fi

/usr/local/sbin/issue-cert.sh
